2.t: ˹This is˺ a reminder of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zachariah

3.t: when he cried out to his Lord privately

4.t: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord
4.tr: Qaala Rabbi innee wahanal 'azmu minnee washta-'alar ra'su shaibanw Wa-lam akun bidu'aaa'ika Rabbi shaqiyyaa

5.t: And I am concerned about ˹the faith of˺ my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So grant me, by Your grace, an heir
5.tr: Wa-innee khiftul mawaaliya minw waraaa'ee Wa-kaanat imra atee 'aqiran fa-hablee mil ladunka waliyyaa

6.t: who will inherit ˹prophethood˺ from me and the family of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, pleasing ˹to You˺!”
6.tr: Yarisunee Wa-yarisu min aali Ya'qoob, waj'alhu Rabbi radiyya

7.t: ˹The angels announced,˺ “O Zachariah! Indeed, We give you the good news of ˹the birth of˺ a son, whose name will be John—a name We have not given to anyone before.”
7.tr: Yaa-Zakariyyaaa innaa nubashshiruka bi-ghulaamin ismuhoo Yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa

8.t: He wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have become extremely old?”
8.tr: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw Wa-kaanat imra-atee 'aaqiranw Wa-qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa

9.t: An angel replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, just as I created you before, when you were nothing!’”
9.tr: Qaala kazaalika qaala Rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw Wa-qad khalaqtuka min qablu Wa-lam taku shai'aa

10.t: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He responded, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three nights, despite being healthy.”
10.tr: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah; qaala Aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa

11.t: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening
11.tr: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw Wa-'ashiyyaa

12.t: ˹It was later said,˺ “O John! Hold firmly to the Scriptures.” And We granted him wisdom while ˹he was still˺ a child
12.tr: Yaa-Yahyaa khuzil Kitaaba biquwwatinw Wa-aatainaahul hukma sabiyyaa

13.t: as well as purity and compassion from Us. And he was God-fearing
13.tr: Wa-hanaanam mil ladunnaa Wa-zakaatanw Wa-kaana taqiyyaa

14.t: and kind to his parents. He was neither arrogant nor disobedient

15.t: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day of his death, and the day he will be raised back to life
15.tr: Wa-salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida Wa-yawma yamootu Wa-yawma yub'asu haiyyaa

16.t: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place in the east
16.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Maryma; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan sharqiyyaa

17.t: screening herself off from them. Then We sent to her Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ appearing before her as a man, perfectly formed
17.tr: Fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa-arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa

18.t: She appealed, “I truly seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you! ˹So leave me alone˺ if you are God-fearing.”
18.tr: Qaalat inneee a'oozu bir-Rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa

19.t: He responded, “I am only a messenger from your Lord, ˹sent˺ to bless you with a pure son.”
19.tr: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu Rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa

20.t: She wondered, “How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me, nor am I unchaste?”
20.tr: Qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw Wa-lam yamsasnee bashrunw Wa-lam aku baghiyyaa

21.t: He replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me. And so will We make him a sign for humanity and a mercy from Us.’ It is a matter ˹already˺ decreed.”
21.tr: Qaala kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki huwa 'alaiya haiyyimunw Wa-linaj-'alahooo Aayatal linnaasi Wa-rahmatam minnaa; Wa-kaana amram maqdiyyaa

22.t: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a remote place

23.t: Then the pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She cried, “Alas! I wish I had died before this, and was a thing long forgotten!”
23.tr: Fa-ajaaa-'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa-laitanee mittu qabla haazaa Wa-kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa

24.t: So a voice reassured her from below her, “Do not grieve! Your Lord has provided a stream at your feet
24.tr: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaaa allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa

25.t: And shake the trunk of this palm tree towards you, it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon you
25.tr: Wa-huzzeee ilaiki bijiz-'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa

26.t: So eat and drink, and put your heart at ease. But if you see any of the people, say, ‘I have vowed silence to the Most Compassionate, so I am not talking to anyone today.’”
26.tr: Fakulee washrabee Wa-qarree 'ainaa; fa-immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir-Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa

27.t: Then she returned to her people, carrying him. They said ˹in shock˺, “O Mary! You have certainly done a horrible thing
27.tr: Fa-atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa-Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa

28.t: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an indecent man, nor was your mother unchaste.”
28.tr: Yaaa-ukhta Haaroona maa kaana abooki mra'a saw'inw Wa-maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa

29.t: So she pointed to the baby. They exclaimed, “How can we talk to someone who is an infant in the cradle?”
29.tr: Fa-ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa

30.t: ˹Jesus˺ declared, “I am truly a servant of Allah. He has destined me to be given the Scripture and to be a prophet
30.tr: Qaala innee 'abdul laahi aataaniyal Kitaaba Wa-ja'alanee Nabiyyaa

31.t: He has made me a blessing wherever I go, and bid me to establish prayer and give alms-tax as long as I live
31.tr: Wa-ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu Wa-awsaanee bis-Salaati waz-Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa

32.t: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant
32.tr: Wa-barram biwaalidatee Wa-lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa

33.t: Peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I will be raised back to life!”
33.tr: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulidtu Wa-yawma amootu Wa-yawma ub'asu haiyaa

34.t: That is Jesus, son of Mary. ˹And this is˺ a word of truth, about which they dispute
34.tr: Zaalika 'Eesab nu Maryama; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon

35.t: It is not for Allah to take a son! Glory be to Him. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is
35.tr: Maa kaana lillaahi aien yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa-yakoon

36.t: ˹Jesus also declared,˺ “Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
36.tr: Wa-innal laaha Rabbee Wa-Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

37.t: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the disbelievers when they face a tremendous Day
37.tr: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu min bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo min mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem

38.t: How clearly will they hear and see on the Day they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly astray
38.tr: Asmi' bihim Wa-absir Yawma ya'toonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalin mubeen

39.t: And warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the Day of Regret, when all matters will be settled, while they are ˹engrossed˺ in heedlessness and disbelief
39.tr: Wa-anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; Wa-hum fee ghaflatinw Wa-hum laa yu'minoon

40.t: Indeed, it is We Who will succeed the earth and whoever is on it. And to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned
40.tr: Innaa nahnu narisul arda Wa-man 'alaihaa Wa-ilainaa yurja'oon

41.t: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Abraham. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet
41.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

42.t: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his father, “O dear father! Why do you worship what can neither hear nor see, nor benefit you at all
42.tr: Iz qaala li-abeehi yaaa-abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u Wa-laa yubsiru Wa-laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa

43.t: O dear father! I have certainly received some knowledge which you have not received, so follow me and I will guide you to the Straight Path
43.tr: Yaaa-abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam ya'tika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa

44.t: O dear father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is ever rebellious against the Most Compassionate
44.tr: Yaaa-abati laa ta'budish Shaitaan; innash Shaitaana kaana lir-Rahmaani 'asiyyaa

45.t: O dear father! I truly fear that you will be touched by a torment from the Most Compassionate, and become Satan’s companion ˹in Hell˺.”
45.tr: Yaaa-abati innee akhaafu aien yamassaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish-Shaitaani waliyyaa

46.t: He threatened, “How dare you reject my idols, O Abraham! If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you ˹to death˺. So be gone from me for a long time!”
46.tr: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa-Ibraaheemu la-'il lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wahjurnee maliyyaa

47.t: Abraham responded, “Peace be upon you! I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness. He has truly been Most Gracious to me
47.tr: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa-astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa

48.t: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”
48.tr: Wa-a'tazilukum Wa-maa tad'oona min doonil laahi Wa-ad'oo Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa

49.t: So after he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet
49.tr: Fa-lam ma'tazalahum Wa-maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa Wa-ya'qoob; Wa-kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa

50.t: We showered them with Our mercy, and blessed them with honourable mention
50.tr: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa Wa-ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa

51.t: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Moses. He was truly a chosen man, and was a messenger and a prophet
51.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw Wa-kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

52.t: We called him from the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and drew him near, speaking ˹with him˺ directly
52.tr: Wa-naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani Wa-qarrabnaahu najiyyaa

53.t: And We appointed for him—out of Our grace—his brother, Aaron, as a prophet
53.tr: Wa-wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa

54.t: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Ishmael. He was truly a man of his word, and was a messenger and a prophet
54.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di Wa-kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

55.t: He used to urge his people to pray and give alms-tax. And his Lord was well pleased with him
55.tr: Wa-kaana ya'muru ahlahoo bis-Salaati waz-zakaati Wa-kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa

56.t: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Enoch. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet
56.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

57.t: And We elevated him to an honourable status

58.t: Those were ˹some of˺ the prophets who Allah has blessed from among the descendants of Adam, and of those We carried with Noah ˹in the Ark˺, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those We ˹rightly˺ guided and chose. Whenever the revelations of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down, prostrating and weeping
58.tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama Wa-mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw Wa-min zurriyyati Ibraaheema Wa-Israaa'eela Wa-mimman hadainaa wajta-bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw Wa-bukiyyaa

59.t: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and followed their lusts and so will soon face the evil consequences
59.tr: Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyyaa

60.t: As for those who repent, believe, and do good, it is they who will be admitted into Paradise, never being denied any reward
60.tr: Illaa man taaba Wa-aamana Wa-'amila saalihan fa-ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata Wa-laa yuzlamoona shai'aa

61.t: ˹They will be in˺ the Gardens of Eternity, promised in trust by the Most Compassionate to His servants. Surely His promise will be fulfilled
61.tr: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo ma'tiyyaa

62.t: There they will never hear any idle talk—only ˹greetings of˺ peace. And there they will have their provisions morning and evening
62.tr: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; Wa-lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw Wa-'ashiyyaa

63.t: That is Paradise, which We will grant to whoever is devout among Our servants
63.tr: Tilkal jannatul latee noorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa

64.t: “We only descend by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us, and whatever is behind us, and everything in between. And your Lord is never forgetful
64.tr: Wa-maa natanazzalu illaa bi-amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa Wa-maa khalfanaa Wa-maa baina zaalik; Wa-maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa

65.t: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens, and the earth, and everything in between. So worship Him ˹alone˺, and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know of anyone equal to Him ˹in His attributes˺?”
65.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa fa'bud-hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa

66.t: Yet ˹some˺ people ask ˹mockingly˺, “After I die, will I really be raised to life again?”
66.tr: Wa-yaqoolul insaanu 'a-izaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa

67.t: Do ˹such˺ people not remember that We created them before, when they were nothing
67.tr: A-Wa-laa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu Wa-lam yaku shai'aa

68.t: By your Lord ˹O Prophet˺! We will surely gather them along with the devils, and then set them around Hell on their knees
68.tr: Fawa-Rabbika lanahshu-rannahum wash-shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa

69.t: Then We will certainly begin by dragging out of every group the ones most defiant to the Most Compassionate
69.tr: Summa lanan-zi'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa

70.t: And We truly know best who is most deserving of burning in it
70.tr: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa

71.t: There is none of you who will not pass over it. ˹This is˺ a decree your Lord must fulfil
71.tr: Wa-in minkum illaa waariduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa

72.t: Then We will deliver those who were devout, leaving the wrongdoers there on their knees
72.tr: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw Wa-nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa

73.t: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers ask the believers ˹mockingly˺, “Which of the two of us is better in status and superior in assembly?”
73.tr: Wa-izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw Wa-ahsanu nadiyyaa

74.t: ˹Imagine, O Prophet˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them, who were far better in luxury and splendour
74.tr: Wa-kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw Wa-ri'yaa

75.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whoever is ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, the Most Compassionate will allow them plenty of time, until—behold!—they face what they are threatened with: either the torment or the Hour. Only then will they realize who is worse in position and inferior in manpower.”
75.tr: Qul man kaana fid da-laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra-aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba Wa-immas Saa'ata fasa-ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw Wa-ad'afu jundaa

76.t: And Allah increases in guidance those who are ˹rightly˺ guided. And the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in outcome
76.tr: Wa-yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal-baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw Wa-khairum maraddaa

77.t: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who rejects Our revelations yet boasts, “I will definitely be granted ˹plenty of˺ wealth and children ˹if there is an afterlife˺.”
77.tr: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi-Aayaatinaa Wa-qaala la-oota-yanna maalanw Wa-waladaa

78.t: Has he looked into the unseen or taken a pledge from the Most Compassionate

79.t: Not at all! We certainly record whatever he claims and will increase his punishment extensively
79.tr: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu Wa-namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa

80.t: And We will inherit what he boasts of, and he will come before Us all by himself

81.t: They have taken other gods, instead of Allah, seeking strength ˹and protection˺ through them
81.tr: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa

82.t: But no! Those ˹gods˺ will deny their worship and turn against them

83.t: Do you ˹O Prophet˺ not see that We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, constantly inciting them
83.tr: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa

84.t: So do not be in haste against them, for indeed We are ˹closely˺ counting down their days
84.tr: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na-'uddu lahum 'addaa

85.t: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as an honoured delegation
85.tr: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa

86.t: and drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd

87.t: None will have the right to intercede, except those who have taken a covenant from the Most Compassionate
87.tr: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ata illaa manit takhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa

88.t: They say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring.”

89.t: You have certainly made an outrageous claim

90.t: by which the heavens are about to burst, the earth to split apart, and the mountains to crumble to pieces
90.tr: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu Wa-tanshaq qul-ardu Wa-takhirrul jibaalu haddaa

91.t: in protest of attributing children to the Most Compassionate

92.t: It does not befit ˹the majesty of˺ the Most Compassionate to have children
92.tr: Wa-maa yambaghee li-Rahmaani aien yattakhiza waladaa

93.t: There is none in the heavens or the earth who will not return to the Most Compassionate in full submission
93.tr: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal-ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa

94.t: Indeed, He fully knows them and has counted them precisely

95.t: And each of them will return to Him on the Day of Judgment all alone

96.t: As for those who believe and do good, the Most Compassionate will ˹certainly˺ bless them with ˹genuine˺ love
96.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati sa-yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa

97.t: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so with it you may give good news to the righteous and warn those who are contentious
97.tr: Fa-innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena Wa-tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa

98.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them! Do you ˹still˺ see any of them, or ˹even˺ hear from them the slightest sound
98.tr: Wa-kam ahlaknaa qabla-hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
